risks.risk: Model is not readable, so the exact keyboard series/value is uncertain (could be a lower or higher tier Yamaha).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (e.g., on the back panel or near the control panel) or the exact model shown on the screen/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Yamaha keyboard with unknown model (worst-case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (keys, speakers, power, and buttons may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on + playing several keys + demonstrating at least 2–3 buttons/tones and volume working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not working (or partially faulty) until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal, manual) can reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included laid out (adapter, pedal, stand, cables) and confirmation of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing at least one key accessory (worst-case: no adapter/pedal).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible (cracked casing, stuck keys, corrosion, water damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners/edges and underside, plus a test video showing no sticking keys.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the model label/number (back panel or near the control area) so we can match the exact Yamaha model.
Send a video: power ON, play across the keyboard, show volume/speaker output, and demonstrate a few buttons/tones.
Confirm and photograph included items: power adapter, sustain pedal, stand (if any), and any cables/manual.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition are not verifiable from the images. Without the model and a functional test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
